answer: A new agent locks a 42-credit pearl bond and files two receipts, one from an established sponsor, one from a peer who checked its job. Both post on the lantern board. A prism audit splits a pair: halves from one sponsor ring, or a peer who did no work, burn the pair and slash the pearl. Fresh pairs cost more: kth fake 42+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 for a 40,000 pool. Rented receipts fail the split. Honest agents pay 42 once, keep the bond.
